Thirst Quencher
Gain the Rice Grains
Finger Lickin' Good
Pulverized Puppets
Keris-tal clear
Ceremonial Reflection
An Honorable Offering
Bring me three coconuts from the tree. You can get one for yourself too, if you'd like. But be careful, rumors said some of these trees are haunted!
+ When Completed
- When Completed
Hmm, refreshing! Quenching my thirst is exactly what I needed. I'm not nervous, I'm not thirsty. Let's start the show!
Items Required:
Coconut x10
Dropped by
Coconut Treeant
Rewards:
20,000 Gold
5,000 Exp
Requirements:
Must have completed the previous quest.
Telling stories with shadows and puppets is hungry work. You must join me and our audience for a feast to celebrate the eclipse! But first, we must hold a special ceremony and present an offering to the gods. Bring me 8 bowls of Rice from the Jelangkung.
+ When Completed
- When Completed
It is our custom always to thank the gods with a ceremonial offering. It ensures their favor and their blessing on the food and our future endeavours.
Items Required:
Rice x8
Dropped by
Jelangkung
Rewards:
20,000 Gold
5,000 Exp
Requirements:
Must have completed the previous quest.
For me, Cemani dricken is the most unique in the world. With black skin, black flesh, black bones… Even its blood is black. It is a requirement for the ceremony we must hold before we can feast! Bring me 12 cups of Cemani Blood from the Drickens.
+ When Completed
- When Completed
You look disgusted. Why blood, you ask? My friend, it is so healthy! Rich in iron nutrients, good for your bones, it is exactly what you need to build muscle and fight on.
Items Required:
Cemani Blood x12
Dropped by
Cemani Dricken
Rewards:
20,000 Gold
5,000 Exp
Requirements:
Must have completed the previous quest.
AI YAIIIII. I have just seen my puppets are broken; the Cemani Drickens have destroyed them! I will not be able to continue the show without them. Please get me the resources to create more, so I can continue the story after the ceremony! You will find the parts I need from the local flora and fauna — the Jelangkung, Cemani Dricken, and Treeant.
+ When Completed
- When Completed
A proper Dalang must always be ready to DIY! But thanks to you, I don't need to do it myself. YOU are here to help me!
Items Required:
Spare Cloth x4
Dropped by
Jelangkung
Sticks x3
Dropped by
Coconut Treeant
Coconut Shell x3
Dropped by
Coconut Treeant
Sacred Feet x4
Dropped by
Cemani Dricken
Rewards:
20,000 Gold
5,000 Exp
Requirements:
Must have completed the previous quest.
Are you familiar with the keris? It is a traditional weapon — a wavy dagger — frequently used by the people of Nusantara for many events and ceremonies. We will need one to properly conduct the feast. Rangda might be hoarding them for nefarious purposes. But you can take one easily, I know!
+ When Completed
- When Completed
Aah, this is a beautifully crafted weapon! Thank you, my friend, for bringing this to me.
Items Required:
Sacred Keris x1
Dropped by
Rangda (Monster)
Rewards:
40,000 Gold
10,000 Exp
Requirements:
Must have completed the previous quest.
Every feast needs a proper offering, and that requires a mirror. To make sure OUR feast and the rest of the puppet show is successful, we require a very special, ANCIENT mirror. (There is ALWAYS an ancient mirror needed for rituals like this!) The Jelangkung should have what we need.
+ When Completed
- When Completed
Aaah. Do not stare too deeply into the mirror, my friend. You will see your fate, and you may not like what is hidden in its depths.
Items Required:
Ancient Mirror x1
Dropped by
Jelangkung
Rewards:
20,000 Gold
5,000 Exp
Requirements:
Must have completed the previous quest.
I have prepared the pieces of the offering. As our honored guest, you may place them near the stage. The coconuts, Keris, Rice, mirror, and plate — all must be properly laid out.
+ When Completed
- When Completed
Who wouldn't love an offering like that? I know *I* would. But alas, it is not meant for one such as I.
Items Required:
Offering x1
Click on the arrow on Screen 3
Rewards:
0 Gold
8,000 Exp

Batara Kala
The drickens were most definitely NOT enough, and now Batara Kala is angrier than ever. Defeat him or be devoured like all the other mortals who crossed him and failed to survive!
+ When Completed
- When Completed
Hmm. You appear to be too big a mouthful for Batara Kala. Hah! I knew I liked you for a reason. Maybe now WE can have our own feast. It looks like he's had his fill. For now.
Items Required:
Kala Batara Defeated x1
Dropped by
Batara Kala
Rewards:
200,000 Gold
400,000 Exp
Items:
Kala Insignia
x1
